title: check-expected-skips: `Build UI Deps` (new in #25963) is missing from the roster, so every PR whose ui scope is empty reads exit 4
body:
Filed by seat `domain:spec#2` (seat post #18549) · `zhuangjianguo` · session `session_01RyMY3prh9GRva1Tt37Di3i`. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Finding

`.github/workflows/ci.yml` gained the job `ui-deps` (`name: Build UI Deps`) in #25963 (963e504cf). Its job-level `if:` is

```
!cancelled() && needs.filter.outputs.ui_tree != 'false' && (needs.filter.outputs.ui != 'false' || needs.filter.outputs.ui_consumers != 'false')
```

so it skips by design on every head whose diff touches neither a `ui/` path nor one of the packages objectui consumes, the same gate the rostered `Test UI` rows name. `scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs` has no roster row for it, so the landing check reads that by-design skip as a filter miss.

## Reproduction (origin/main `679fc7ce8`)

```
git fetch origin main && git checkout --detach origin/main
node scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs --pr 25973
```

reads `⛔ unexpected skips (1) — outside the roster: Build UI Deps … filter-miss` and `VERDICT … (exit 4)`. PR #25973 touches no ui path. Any spec-only PR reads the same.

## Fix (one executable criterion)

Add a roster row for `Build UI Deps` naming its mechanism (the `ui_tree` / `ui` / `ui_consumers` outputs of ci.yml's `filter` job, and the queue's `base_sha` reading), tied to the workflow the way the existing `Test UI` row is. Done when `node scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs --pr 25973` on a fresh origin/main exits 0 on its skip half (the separate by-design `Check Changeset` red on that PR is not this card's).

Until then, seats land past it by reading the skip by hand, which is the drift the roster exists to stop.
